statement: Cejel #644's v27 A1 allowlist credited a pytest hook with putting the collected items back when every statement was a copy, an emptying, a restore, a same-file helper call, a docstring or a report (config.hook.pytest_deselected, print, a logging call). Review at bca7ebfbf found pytest 9.2.0 ran no test while the note said the items were back: the same conftest.py implemented pytest_deselected to clear session.items; print(W) and log.warning(W) ran a W.__str__ that cleared it; a star import, setattr(sys.modules[__name__], "li" + "st", ...), sys.modules[__name__].tuple = ... or a self-import assigning conftest.list rebound a trusted name the file never spelled. Rule: an allowlist that admits a call trusts every name the call can reach, so admit no call that can run code outside the proved steps, and refuse the credit where the module can rebind a trusted name without spelling it. Fix: report calls left the allowlist, and such modules send the hook to the named not-read outcome.
